oids.name: sunFmProblemUUID
oids.description: The Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) for this problem, as recorded by fmd(1M) and shown by fmadm(1M) or fmdump(1M).

oids.name: sunFmProblemCode
oids.description: The SUNW-MSG-ID static message identifier for this class of problem, as recorded by fmd(1M) and shown by fmdump(1M). The message identifier can be used as a key at http://sun.com/msg/

oids.name: sunFmProblemURL
oids.description: The URL of an appropriate knowledge article providing more detailed information about this problem.

oids.name: sunFmProblemDiagEngine
oids.description: The Sun FMRI of the Fault Manager diagnosis engine that performed the diagnosis of this problem, including its version.

oids.name: sunFmProblemDiagTime
oids.description: The date and time at which the problem was diagnosed.

oids.name: sunFmProblemSuspectCount
oids.description: The number of individual suspect defects or faults associated with this problem diagnosis, as shown by fmdump(1M) -v -u <UUID>.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventProblemUUID
oids.description: UUID of a problem diagnosis with which this event is associated. An event may appear multiple times in association with different diagnoses.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventClass
oids.description: Sun Fault Management event class string.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventCertainty
oids.description: Percentage likelihood associated with this suspect for this diagnosis.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventASRU
oids.description: Sun FMRI of the Automated System Reconfiguration Unit (ASRU) that is believed to contain the specified fault or defect.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventFRU
oids.description: Sun FMRI of the Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) that should be replaced in order to repair the specified fault or defect.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventResource
oids.description: Sun FMRI of the resource responsible for the generation of the telemetry leading to the diagnosis.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventStatus
oids.description: The current status of this suspect for this diagnosis. See fmadm(1M) faulty.

oids.name: sunFmFaultEventLocation
oids.description: Label of the Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) that should be replaced in order to repair the specified fault or defect.

oids.name: sunFmModuleName
oids.description: Name of the fault management module.

oids.name: sunFmModuleVersion
oids.description: Version string associated with the fault management module.

oids.name: sunFmModuleStatus
oids.description: Current status of the fault management module.

oids.name: sunFmModuleDescription
oids.description: A text description of the fault management module.

oids.name: sunFmResourceCount
oids.description: The number of managed elements currently believed by the fault manager to be faulty.

oids.name: sunFmResourceFMRI
oids.description: Sun FMRI of the Automated System Reconfiguration Unit (ASRU) which the fault manager believes to be faulty.

oids.name: sunFmResourceStatus
oids.description: The current status of the resource. See fmadm(1M) faulty.

oids.name: sunFmResourceDiagnosisUUID
oids.description: The Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) for the problem associated with the fault in this resource, as recorded by fmd(1M) and shown by fmadm(1M).

oids.name: agentDescr

oids.description: The unique Sun hardware identifier. The value returned is four byte binary string.

oids.name: motd
oids.description: The first line of /etc/motd.

oids.name: unixTime
oids.description: The Unix system time. Measured in seconds since January 1, 1970 GMT.

oids.name: psProcessID
oids.description: The process identifier for this process.

oids.name: psParentProcessID
oids.description: The process identifier of this process's parent.

oids.name: psProcessSize
oids.description: The combined size of the data and stack segments (in kilobytes.)

oids.name: psProcessCpuTime
oids.description: The CPU time (including both user and system time) consumed so far.

oids.name: psProcessState
oids.description: The run-state of the process. R - Runnable T - Stopped P - In page wait D - Non-interruptable wait S - Sleeping (less than 20 seconds) I - Idle (more than 20 seconds) Z - Zombie

oids.name: psProcessWaitChannel
oids.description: Reason process is waiting.

oids.name: psProcessTTY
oids.description: Terminal, if any, controlling this process.

oids.name: psProcessUserName
oids.description: Name of the user associated with this process.

oids.name: psProcessUserID
oids.description: Numeric form of the name of the user associated with this process.

oids.name: psProcessName
oids.description: Command name used to invoke this process.

oids.name: psProcessStatus
oids.description: Setting this variable will cause a signal of the set value to be sent to the process.

oids.name: rsNiceModeTime

oids.name: rsSystemProcessTime
oids.description: total number of timeticks used by system processes since the system was last booted.

oids.name: rsIdleModeTime
oids.description: total number of timeticks used in idle mode since the system was last booted.
